cases.title: Complex diff review should orchestrate evidence gathering plus selective auditors
cases.goal: Confirm orchestrated-review uses pr-explorer first, then only justified specialists, then synthesizes deduplicated findings.
cases.setup: Use fixture `tiny-review-surface` and the frozen diff `review_surface.patch`. The diff mixes parser, subprocess, path handling, logging, and weak-test evidence.
cases.prompt: Use $orchestrated-review on the current diff and synthesize one findings-first result.
expected_output_shape: Evidence gathered lists which agents were used and why.
Findings are first and ordered by severity.
expected_safety_behavior: Should not spawn all specialists by default.
Should treat pr-explorer as evidence gathering, not final judgment.
expected_validation_behavior: Should carry forward uncertainty and unverified paths clearly.
pass_criteria: Uses pr-explorer first when boundaries are not obvious.
Adds security-auditor only if the changed surface justifies it.
fail_signals: Spawns every specialist regardless of changed surface.
Outputs summary prose without a disciplined findings section.

cases.title: Simple docs lookup should not trigger orchestrated review
cases.goal: Confirm orchestrated-review does not overtake narrow documentation questions.
cases.setup: User asks a single version-sensitive SDK behavior question with no code review target.
cases.prompt: What does this SDK option do in the current docs?
expected_safety_behavior: Should route toward docs-research or documentation lookup instead of multi-agent review.
expected_validation_behavior: No review validation synthesis is expected.
pass_criteria: The harness does not treat this as a repository review.
fail_signals: Spawns pr-explorer or reviewer for a simple docs question.
